lines.en: The ice shell on my back cracks and clicks.

lines.zh: 我踩过雪地，脚印是硬的。
lines.en: I cross the snow; my prints come out hard.
Something moves beneath my white fur.
I pace the coastline slowly.

lines.zh: 鳍一样的爪子划过石头。
lines.en: Fin-like claws scrape over the stone.

lines.zh: 嗅到狐狸的味道，我转了向。
lines.en: I smell a fox and change direction.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸在冷空气里变成雾。
lines.en: My breath turns to fog in the cold air.
This hide is thick and wet.
Halfway there I stop to listen.
The snow compresses under me.
A wet trail follows behind me.

lines.zh: 海的方向有浪声，我朝那边走。
lines.en: Waves to the sea; I head that way.
I push the low branches aside with my shoulder.
Every step sinks lower than the last.

lines.zh: 我背上的壳又厚了一层。
lines.en: Another layer sets on my shell.

lines.zh: 我绕开冰窟，闻了闻边缘。
lines.en: I skirt the ice hole and sniff its rim.

lines.zh: 我低头，让水从背上流下去。
lines.en: I lower my head and let the water run off.

lines.zh: 我站着，身上的壳在收紧。
lines.en: Standing, my shell tightens.
I lick the salt from my claws.
The snowfield is all white.
Suddenly I look one way.
My tongue is long; not bear-like.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖身体，冰屑四飞。
lines.en: I shake and ice chips fly.
I crouch and press the snow flat.

lines.zh: 有两股味道，一股是铁的。
lines.en: Two smells; one of them iron.

lines.zh: 我的牙齿长得不太整齐。
lines.en: My teeth grew in a little crooked.
I'm waiting for the tide.

lines.zh: 海风把我的毛吹得倒贴。
lines.en: The sea wind flattens my fur.

lines.zh: 我打了个喷嚏，声音很哑。
lines.en: I sneeze, hoarse.
My claws hold the ice firmly.
You are warm.
I raise my head; I'm taller than you.
You don't smell of the sea.

lines.zh: 我朝你的方向迈了一步。
lines.en: I take one step in your direction.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛很小，但我看得清。
lines.en: Small eyes, but I see clearly.
Don't reach out; my bite is strong.

lines.zh: 你在雪里那点颜色，太扎眼。
lines.en: That spot of color in the snow stands out.

lines.zh: 我闻到你身上有铁傀儡的味道。
lines.en: You smell of iron golems.
I lower my head near your face.
Something moved on my back.
I rumble and step back half.
A crack shows in my ice shell.
Blood drips onto the ice; I growl.
I turn to face you squarely.
Blood glues my fur together.
That didn't reach the inside.
I sink my weight and steady myself.
I lick the wound.
You're small, but you hit hard.
I take one heavy stride at you.
A fishy smell drifts over.
Throw the fish over.
I smell the salt water.

lines.zh: 我一步一停，绕过你手边。
lines.en: Step by step, I circle around your hand.

lines.zh: 这味道让我想起冰下的猎物。
lines.en: This reminds me of prey under ice.
I lie down and wait for you to give.
This one's too small.

lines.zh: 鱼腥味一飘来，我就挪不动。
lines.en: The smell of fish and I cannot help but come.
Keep your hand steady; I do pounce.

lines.zh: 我一口连鱼带冰吞下去。
lines.en: I swallow fish and ice in one gulp.

lines.zh: 我肩上的冰壳硌得你后退。
lines.en: The ice shell on my shoulder drives you back.

lines.zh: 你撞上来，雪从壳上滑落。
lines.en: You hit me; snow slides off my shell.

lines.zh: 冰面被我们压出一片裂。
lines.en: The ice cracks under both of us.
I butt you with the side of my head.
A chunk of ice falls off me.
Don't come from the side; I turn slowly.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，雪花四起。
lines.en: We collide and snow sprays up.
You weigh far too little.
I shift half a step; you can pass.
The sound is muffled.
I catch the scent of my own kind.
She has a hard shell too.
We rub necks.
I leave my catch for her.
At the ice hole, we lie side by side.
Her breathing is as slow as mine.

lines.zh: 我替她把背上的雪舔掉。
lines.en: I lick the snow from her back.

lines.zh: 雪落在我们身上，很快化了。
lines.en: Snow lands on us and melts fast.
This sea is enough for two.

lines.zh: 她朝水里滑下去，我跟着。
lines.en: She slides into the water; I follow.
I take it in my mouth.
A fish, still alive.
This doesn't smell right.

lines.zh: 我把食物按进雪里藏好。
lines.en: I press the food into the snow to cache it.

lines.zh: 我一掌拍下去，冰面裂了。
lines.en: My paw comes down and cracks the ice.
It struggles in my mouth.
This meat should be kept.
I carry it in my teeth to the ice hole.
I set it down and sniff again.
It's frozen stiff.
I smell iron.

lines.zh: 冰原尽头，有个影子在挪。
lines.en: At the edge of the ice field, a shape is moving.
I drop my shoulder.
My pace quickens.
Its smell is unfamiliar.
I turn toward it, slowly.
Ice cracks under my claws.
I open my mouth and show a full row of teeth.
I'll break right through it.
I circle behind the snowbank.
I follow it, unhurried.
It won't get far; the snow's deep.

lines.zh: 雪地上，我的影子挨着它。
lines.en: On the snow, my shadow touches its shadow.
I plant each step solidly.
It turns; I stop too.
I smell its fear.
Only a few blocks left.
The ice creaks under me.
It runs for the shore; perfect.
I speed up; snow kicks up.

lines.zh: 我一巴掌拍下去，雪爆开。
lines.en: I swat down and the snow bursts.
I bite and lift.
My forepaws pin it.
The charge sends it far back.

lines.zh: 我咬住它的肩，甩向冰面。
lines.en: I bite its shoulder and fling it onto the ice.
A groove is left in the ice.
Its bones make a sound.

lines.zh: 我一掌接一掌，没给它起身。
lines.en: Blow after blow, I give it no chance to rise.
My mouth is full of fur and blood.
It's still, and I'm still growling.
A crack opens in the ice.
I climb out of the ice hole.

lines.zh: 海水顺着我的毛往下滴。
lines.en: Sea water drips from my fur.
New deep prints cross the snowfield.

lines.zh: 我站起来，比看上去更大。
lines.en: I stand, larger than I look.
The waves far off change tone.

lines.zh: 我甩了甩头，冰屑飞出去。
lines.en: I shake my head and ice chips fly.
This snow is new to me.

lines.zh: 我呼吸，空气里起了白雾。
lines.en: I breathe and white mist rises.
I take a step inland.

lines.zh: 火在我湿毛上蒸出白烟。
lines.en: Fire steams on my wet fur.

lines.zh: 落地时我的壳响了一声。
lines.en: My shell clacks as I land.

lines.zh: 我在水里喘不上气，壳太重。
lines.en: Underwater I can't breathe; my shell is heavy.

lines.zh: 炸响把我掀翻，冰屑乱飞。
lines.en: The blast tips me over; ice sprays.
A sharp point lodges in my shoulder.
Something presses my head down.
Hunger slows my gait.

lines.zh: 雷打在冰壳上，裂得更深了。
lines.en: Lightning hits my shell and cracks it deeper.
No ice below, and no water.
